context: Chromium headless capture of DOM compositions
symptom: Scaled text looked soft and differed between renders of the same t
root_cause: translate3d promotes a compositor layer; Chromium reuses its raster at a previous scale
fix: Use 2D translate() unless real 3D; set gsap.config({force3D:false})
verification: kinetic-type re-render; DOM digest identical across seek orders; eval A passes
reuse_condition: Any DOM text that scales or moves in renders

symptom: Same t gave pixel diffs (max 132) on text with identical DOM
root_cause: Chromium glyph raster-cache history changes anti-aliasing
fix: Compare composition state (inline styles, text, canvas pixels) instead of screenshots
verification: recovery eval: reference fix passes, Math.random jitter still caught

symptom: FONT_MISSING / glyph swap on early frames
root_cause: FontFace loads lazily when first used; fonts.ready doesn't cover unused faces
fix: Load every declared FontFace before frame 0 (MF.compose does this); local files, font-display:block
verification: webgl template: serif em no longer flagged; stills PASS

symptom:
Italic/colour lost after split; 'Faster.' became 'Faster .';
dropped
root_cause: Splitter flattened inline elements and treated element boundaries as word breaks
fix: Fragment model: keep inline wrappers, glue fragments without whitespace, keep
verification: kinetic-type and social-916 stills show styled words and designed breaks
reuse_condition: Splitting any text containing inline markup

symptom: TEXT_CLIPPED_BY_FRAME false positives mid-reveal
root_cause: Text rect not intersected with clipping ancestors (masks, clip-path)
fix: Intersect text rect with every clipping ancestor below the stage
verification: kinetic-type stills PASS at 7.4s mid-reveal

symptom: 'MF: bad position act2-0.35' and setup crash
root_cause: Position syntax needs -= / += after a label
fix: Use 'label-=0.35' / 'label+=0.35'
verification: brand-film eval D renders after fix

symptom: letterSpacing differed between engines
root_cause: GSAP treats bare numbers as px; MF used em
fix: Pass CSS lengths with units as strings ('0.12em')
verification: parity sheet: MF and GSAP 3.15 frames match
reuse_condition: Any non-px CSS length in tweens

symptom: Wordmark letters appeared on top of the mark while it slid away
root_cause: Later DOM element painted above the moving mark
fix: Give the occluder a higher z-index and delay letters until it clears
verification: gsap template stills at 2.5s clean
reuse_condition: Elements that should emerge from behind another

context: Type over a procedural shader field
symptom: Contour lines crossed the title, hurting legibility
root_cause: Field had no reserved type zone
fix: In-shader scrim attenuating line alpha under type zones
verification: webgl template crop at 6.5s legible

symptom: Field filled the frame; title sat on busy geometry; signal row read as noise
root_cause: Camera aimed at field centre and too close; random heights on highlighted row
fix: Aim camera off-centre, raise/pull back to reserve sky for type; uniform rule for the highlighted set
verification: threejs template final frame: clean sky for type, signal wall reads as one line

symptom: Setup errors reported as 'never exposed __MF' with no message
root_cause: waitForFunction awaited the rejected ready promise returned by the predicate
fix: Predicate returns boolean; await ready separately and surface the rejection stack
verification: recovery eval stage 1 shows 'TypeError … at render'
reuse_condition: Waiting on page promises from Playwright

symptom: TYPE_ORPHAN false positives mid-animation and on chars splits
root_cause: Measured transformed glyph positions per fragment
fix: Measure untransformed unit boxes (word mask / char word box); skip designed
verification: gsap template stills at 2.75s PASS

symptom: Copy ran into the right platform-UI margin and the checker stayed silent
root_cause: QA only checked the frame edge, not platform safe zones
fix: QA reports TEXT_OUTSIDE_SAFE_ZONE using MF.compose safeZones (auto 9:16 for portrait); size display type to the safe column
verification: Quire 9:16: flagged 3 lines, PASS after resizing

symptom: TEXT_OVERFLOWS_BOX on struck-through words
root_cause: scrollWidth counts absolutely positioned decorative children
fix: Compare the text range width to clientWidth instead of scrollWidth
verification: Quire strike bars no longer flagged; overset split and unsplit headlines still flagged (base template test)

context: Split-word mask reveals with tight leading (line-height < 1)
symptom: Small stray marks where hidden words sat (tail of g/y after a -110% exit)
root_cause: Glyph ink overhangs the line box; the mask's descender padding lets it through
fix: Hide split units once |yPercent| >= 100 (MF engine does this); with GSAP exit at ±130% or add autoAlpha:0
verification: brand-film fixture frame 7.0s clean after fix; eval D passes
reuse_condition: Masked word/line reveals with display type and descenders

symptom: Labels that look fine in CSS fail measured contrast; color-mix() colours misread as near-black
root_cause: Small labels need 4.5:1 not 3:1; getComputedStyle returns color(srgb 0-1) for color-mix results
fix: Score from pixels with --score; parse color(srgb); darken mutes to ~#6B6862 on warm white
verification: All templates PASS --score; planted faint text detected (eval I)
reuse_condition: Any composition with small grey labels or color-mix colours

context: Copy over a 3D planet / footage plate in 9:16
symptom: Fact text unreadable over busy surface; subject filled the frame
root_cause: Subject and type competed for the same band
fix: Move the subject (camera distance + object Y per act) to leave a clean band, plus a gradient scrim behind the type zone
verification: whatif-3d stills PASS with --score; visual check of contact sheet

context: Three.js post-processing (depth of field) in deterministic renders
symptom: Determinism check failed: same t rendered differently on first vs later visits
root_cause: Two causes: (1) a transparent ring at opacity 0 still wrote depth that the DOF pass read; (2) ring.lookAt(camera) ran before the camera was placed for this t
fix: visible=false instead of opacity 0; place the camera first in render(t); warm up render targets in setup
verification: repeat-seek hashes identical; whatif-3d stills PASS incl. determinism
reuse_condition: Any WebGL scene with post-processing or objects facing the camera

symptom: Text in the outer 5% of a landscape frame was never flagged
root_cause: Safe-zone QA ran only for portrait/explicit frames
fix: Default title-safe (5%) for landscape; HUD margins ≥ 9.5u on 1080p templates
verification: MotionBench offsafe mutation detected on landscape templates after the change

context: Splitting a composition into layers for an editor (Resolve/Premiere)
symptom: Recombined layers put the title above the end card
root_cause: All non-background elements went into one 'graphics' layer, losing the paint order
fix: One layer per top-level stage child, ordered by paint order from the runtime (meta.layers); data-mf-layer splits inner elements
verification: Recombined ProRes layers vs full render: SSIM 0.997–0.9997 (nle-check --ref)
reuse_condition: splitting a comp into editor layers

symptom: Pack copied the whole source file once per clip; the editor would have to trim 14 clips by hand
root_cause: CapCut has no timeline import, so source in/out points in layout.json are useless to it
fix: Pre-cut (and pre-zoom) every clip to its own file in timeline order; dialogue stays inside the clips; alpha layers get a key-colour twin
verification: nle-check counts frames of each pre-cut clip; concatenated clips vs the cut: SSIM ≥ 0.99, within 1 frame
reuse_condition: delivering to an editor without timeline import

symptom: Scaled drafts (--scale 0.5) came out slightly different from Playwright captures (SSIM 0.995)
root_cause: CDP captures CSS pixels and ignores a deviceScaleFactor below 1; the pipeline then downscaled a full-size frame
fix: Use the CDP path only at scale 1; scaled renders keep Playwright screenshots
verification: framemd5 identical old vs new at scale 1 on captions + kinetic templates; eval L
reuse_condition: changing the capture path or deviceScaleFactor

context: Frame dedupe (reuse the previous capture when nothing changed)
symptom: Risk of frozen motion when the change is invisible to a DOM hash
root_cause: Canvas/video/animated images/shadow DOM/CSS rule edits don't show in element attributes
fix: Hash every element + text + CSS rule text + running animations; return null (force capture) when canvas/video/iframe/animated images/shadow roots exist
verification: Bit-identical output vs no-dedupe on captions (120/150 reused) and kinetic (107/300 reused)
